connector.name: Agent Ready
connector.registryDescription: Scan any URL for AI agent readability - Vercel Spec, llmstxt.org, and agent-protocol manifests.
connector.summary: Hosted at agent-ready.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agent-ready-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mlava account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AGENT_READY_API_KEY
env.description: Agent Ready Pro API key for scan_site and get_scan. ask and validate_structured_data work without one. Issue a key at https://agent-ready.dev/dashboard/api-keys.
